description: This file contains utility functions and templates for string manipulation, case-insensitive comparisons, trimming, encoding, and other string-related operations within the Utils::String namespace. It also defines a locale-aware equality struct and several helper functions for string processing.

classes.name: loc_equal
classes.description: A template struct for locale-aware character equality comparison.

methods.name: find_substr_ci
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search for a substring within a string, returning the position or -1 if not found.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a given substring in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Removes trailing whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from both ends of a string.

methods.name: stringContains
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive substring check between two strings.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on delimiters.

methods.name: imageEncoder
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string.

methods.name: removeExtraWhitespaces
methods.description: Removes extra spaces from an input string, producing a cleaned output string.
